pli-tv-bi-vb-pc39:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc39:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo antovassaṃ cārikaṃ caranti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc39:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo antovassaṃ cārikaṃ carissanti haritāni tiṇāni sammaddantā ekindriyaṃ jīvaṃ viheṭhentā bahū khuddake pāṇe saṅghāṭaṃ āpādentāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc39:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc39:1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc39:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo antovassaṃ cārikaṃ carissantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc39:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo antovassaṃ cārikaṃ carantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc39:1.11: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo antovassaṃ cārikaṃ carissanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc39:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc39:1.14.1: yā pana bhikkhunī antovassaṃ cārikaṃ careyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc39:2.1.6: purimaṃ vā temāsaṃ pacchimaṃ vā temāsaṃ avasitvā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc39:2.1.8: kukkuṭasaṃpāte gāme gāmantare gāmantare āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc39:2.1.9: agāmake araññe aḍḍhayojane aḍḍhayojane āpatti pācittiyassa.
